description.fallback: 按真实日期切换春夏秋冬的 Aria 形象，为启动器的各区域换季；四季各有不同的穿搭、动作与道具。Switches Aria's artwork and palette between spring, summer, autumn and winter by date; each season has its own outfit, pose and prop.

status.fallback: 需要启动器 0.1.0 及以上版本内的 Aria 渲染器。本包提供立绘与清单；季节判断、配色与摆放由启动器实现。

artwork.note: Described here for humans and for future loader versions. The 0.1.0 launcher ignores unknown manifest fields and reads its own bundled copy of this artwork from /plugins/aria-with-you/, so installing this package does not by itself change what the launcher draws.
